config.script:
# Collapse all active entries
	self.parent.parent.parent.getChild("Accordion").setExpansion("all", True)

	# Log All BOM entires expanded
	system.util.audit(action="Expanded", actionTarget="BOM", actionValue="All %d Entries" % (len(self.parent.parent.parent.getChild("Accordion").custom.items)))

	# Save collapsed state for all gateways
	for gateway in self.parent.parent.parent.getChild("Accordion").custom.visibility.gateways.keys():
		self.parent.parent.parent.getChild("Accordion").custom.visibility.gateways[gateway]["entryExpanded"] = True

# Collapse all active entries
	self.parent.parent.parent.getChild("Accordion").setExpansion("all", False)

	# Log All BOM entires collapsed
	system.util.audit(action="Collapsed", actionTarget="BOM", actionValue="All %d Entries" % (len(self.parent.parent.parent.getChild("Accordion").custom.items)))

	# Save collapsed state for all gateways
	for gateway in self.parent.parent.parent.getChild("Accordion").custom.visibility.gateways.keys():
		self.parent.parent.parent.getChild("Accordion").custom.visibility.gateways[gateway]["entryExpanded"] = False

customMethods.name: setExpansion

messageHandlers.script:
#  http://architecture-buildout.localtest.me/data/perspective/client/ArchitectureBuildOut/BOM#Icc7fcaa2

	gwAddr=self.session.props.gateway.address
	if gwAddr[-1]==':':
		gwAddr=gwAddr[:-1]
	project = system.util.getProjectName()

	url='{}/data/perspective/client/{}/BOM#{}'.format(gwAddr, project, payload['uuid'])
	system.perspective.navigate(url=url)

# Incoming payload should include 'source', 'uuid', and 'value'
	if payload["source"] == "entry":
		# Update active expansion state
		self.getChild("Accordion").setExpansion(payload["uuid"], payload["value"])

		# Save updated expansion state
		self.getChild("Accordion").custom.visibility.gateways[payload["uuid"]]["entryExpanded"] = payload["value"]

	elif payload["source"] in ("IA", "CL", "SS", "TPM"):
		self.getChild("Accordion").custom.visibility.gateways[payload["uuid"]]["expanded"][payload["source"]] = payload["value"]
